shellCommands.command: git diff package.json && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -50

for f in next.config.ts lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/; grep -ril "prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -40
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides; cat adopting-partial-prefetching.md optimizing-prefetching.md

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; cat 04-functions/prefetch.md; ls 05-config/01-next-config-js | grep -i prefetch; cat 05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md 2>/dev/null | head -80; cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; cat 02-guides/keeping-pages-static.md | head -250; grep -n -i "prefetch()" -r 03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/ 04-glossary.md | head

git diff --stat; find .next/server/app -path '*product*' -type f | head -30; for f in $(find .next/server/app -path '*product*' -name '*.rsc' -o -path '*product*' -name '*.segment.rsc' | head -20); do echo "== $f"; grep -o 'Compact Widget\|Loading related' $f | sort -u; done
cat .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc; echo; echo ----; cat .next/server/app/product.meta
cd node_modules/next/dist; grep -o "'[Nn]ext-[A-Za-z-]*'" -rh client/components/app-router-headers.js | sort -u; grep -n "RSC_HEADER\|PREFETCH" client/components/app-router-headers.js | head -40
ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls /workspace/node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"

cd /workspace && (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
for mode in 1 2 3; do echo "=== next-router-prefetch: $mode (segment /product/__PAGE__)"; curl -s -H 'rsc: 1' -H "next-router-prefetch: $mode" -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /product/__PAGE__' http://localhost:3123/product | grep -o 'Compact Widget\|Loading related products' | sort | uniq -c; done
echo "=== full (non-segment) prefetch mode 2"; curl -s -D - -H 'rsc: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 2' http://localhost:3123/product -o /tmp/p2.txt | grep -i 'x-nextjs\|content-type'; grep -o 'Compact Widget\|Loading related products' /tmp/p2.txt | sort | uniq -c

cat /tmp/next.log; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3123/product; curl -s -D - -H 'rsc: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 1' -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /product/__PAGE__' http://localhost:3123/product | head -c 1500

probe() { curl -sL -D /tmp/h.txt "$@" http://localhost:3123/product -o /tmp/b.txt; grep -i 'x-nextjs\|x-next-\|cache' /tmp/h.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^/   /'; printf '   '; grep -o 'Compact Widget\|Loading related products' /tmp/b.txt | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ' '; echo; }
for mode in 1 2 3; do echo "== prefetch $mode, segment __PAGE__"; probe -H 'rsc: 1' -H "next-router-prefetch: $mode" -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /product/__PAGE__'; done
for mode in 1 2 3; do echo "== prefetch $mode, no segment"; probe -H 'rsc: 1' -H "next-router-prefetch: $mode"; done
echo "== navigation"; probe -H 'rsc: 1'
cd node_modules/next/dist; grep -rl "function prefetch()" server/ api/ 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "prefetch()" server/request/*.js 2>/dev/null | head
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache; ls; grep -n -i "stage" cache.js | head -60

cd /workspace; f=.next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc; wc -c $f; grep -bo 'Compact Widget\|Loading related products\|^19:.*' $f; sed -n 1490,1570p node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/cache.js; grep -n "AppStage = \|Shell\] = \|Prefetch\] = \|Navigation\] = " node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/types.js

cd /workspace; pkill -f "next start" ; cp app/product/page.tsx /tmp/page.bak; sed -i '/await prefetch()/d; /import { prefetch }/d' app/product/page.tsx; npx next build >/dev/null 2>&1; f=.next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc; echo "control:"; grep -bo 'Compact Widget\|"a":"[^"]*"' $f; grep -o '^[0-9a-f]*:\[[0-9,]*\]$' $f; cp /tmp/page.bak app/product/page.tsx; npx next build >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "with prefetch():"; grep -bo 'Compact Widget\|"a":"[^"]*"' $f; grep -o '^[0-9a-f]*:\[[0-9,]*\]$' $f; git diff --stat
cd /workspace; diff /tmp/page.bak app/product/page.tsx && echo same; pgrep -af "next start"

cd /workspace; sed -i '/await prefetch()/d; /import { prefetch }/d' app/product/page.tsx; npx next build >/dev/null 2>&1; f=.next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc; echo "control:"; grep -bo 'Compact Widget' $f; grep -o '^[0-9a-f]*:\[[0-9,]*\]$' $f; cp /tmp/page.bak app/product/page.tsx; npx next build >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "with prefetch():"; grep -bo 'Compact Widget' $f; grep -o '^[0-9a-f]*:\[[0-9,]*\]$' $f; git diff --stat
git checkout tsconfig.json && git diff --stat
